Voice Change - বাচ্য পরিবর্তন (Active & Passive)
Identify the correct passive form of the sentence: “Who will do the work”?
Whom the work will be done? | By whom will the work be done? | Who the work will be done by? | By who the work will be done?

Who যুক্ত Active voice কে passive করতে হলে who এর পরিবর্তে by whom বসে। এরপর auxiliary verb, object টি subject, be/being/been, main verb এর past participle form বসে। গঠনটি হলো: By whom + auxiliary verb + sub + be/being been + v.p.p.
The passive form of ‘We called him a fool’ is-
He had been called a fool by us. | He was called a fool by us. | He is called a fool by us. | He has been called a fool by us.
Call, choose, elect, make, name, select, nominated ইত্যাদি factitive verb গুলোর Passive voice করার নিয়ম হলো: Object + was + factitive verb এর past participle + factitive object + by + subject.
Identify the correct passive form of “Who did this”?
By whom was this done? | By whom has this done? | By whom this has been done? | By whom this had been done?

Past indefinite tense-এ থাকা who যুক্ত active voice-কে passive করার নিয়ম: By whom + was / were + sub + V3 (মূল verb - এর past participle) + ? অর্থাৎ who এর পরিবর্তে By whom ব্যবহৃত হয় + মূল verb past tense - এর হওয়ায় (এখানে did মূল verb) was ব্যবহৃত হয় + object টি subject হয় (এখানে this) + মূল verb - এর past participle হয়। সুতরাং সঠিক passive form হচ্ছে By whom was this done?
She played on the flute. Passive form is –
The flute was played by her. | The flute was played on by her. | The flute was played to her. | The flute was being played by her.

passive voice এর ক্ষেত্রে active voice এর object, subject হবে, active voice এর tense এবং object অনুসারে auxiliary verb বসে। মূল Verb এর past participle হয় এবং তারপর by বসে। এখানে preposition 'on' মূল verb-এর সাথেই যুক্ত থাকবে: The flute was played on by her.
The passive form of the sentence: ‘I knew the man.
The man was known at me. | The man was known to me. | The man is known by me. | The man was known with me.
Know verb-এর passive voice-এ preposition হিসেবে by-এর পরিবর্তে to বসে। বাক্যটি Past Indefinite tense-এ থাকায়: The man was known to me.
Identify the correct passive form: “Do you see the flower?”
Is the flower was seen by you? | Is the flower being seen by you? | Has the flower seen by you? | Is the flower seen by you?
Interrogative: Do/does sentence-কে passive করার নিয়ম: am / is / are + obj + v3 + by + sub + ? অর্থাৎ সঠিক passive form হচ্ছে Is the flower seen by you?
What is the correct active form of: “It has to be done by me.”
I must do it. | I have to do it. | I should do it. | I must have done it.
Have to / has to যুক্ত passive বাক্যকে active করার নিয়ম: Subject + have to/has to + Verb এর base form + Object। তাই It has to be done by me এর active form হলো I have to do it।
‘You are requested to open the door.’ The active form of the above sentence is-
The door is to be opened. | Let the door be opened. | Please open the door. | I requested you to open the door.

Imperative sentence-এ অনুরোধ বোঝালে passive voice-এ 'You are requested to' ব্যবহৃত হয়। তাই এর active রূপ হবে Please + verb এর base form + extension। সুতরাং সঠিক active বাক্য হলো: Please open the door.
"I was given a cheque'. What is the active form?
A cheque is given to me. | He gave me a cheque | I gave him a cheque | I got a cheque

I was given a cheque বাক্যটি Past Indefinite Tense-এর passive voice। এখানে agent উহ্য আছে। Active করতে সাবজেক্ট হিসেবে He এনে Past form 'gave' এবং indirect object 'me' ও direct object 'a cheque' বসিয়ে বাক্যটি হবে: He gave me a cheque।
Find out the correct passive form of the sentence: 'I had killed the bird.'
The bird was killed by me. | The bird had been killed by me. | The bird was being killed by me. | I had been killed the bird.
Past perfect tense-এর passive voice করার নিয়ম: Object কে Subject + had been + Verb এর Past participle + by + Subject কে Object। সুতরাং সঠিক passive form: The bird had been killed by me.
Open the window; Identify the correct passive form:
The window should be opened. | Let the window be opened. | Let the window be opened by you. | The window must be opened.
মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া Imperative sentence-কে passive করার নিয়ম: Let + object + be + verb এর past participle। সুতরাং Open the window এর passive হলো Let the window be opened.
The active form of- “The door should be kept shut” is-
Shut the door | Let us shut the door | Let the door be shut | You should shut the door

ইংরেজি বাক্য Imperative হলে অর্থাৎ বাক্য মূল Verb দ্বারা শুরু হলে নিচের মতো করে বাক্যকে Passive করতে হয়ঃ Let + object + be + verb এর Past participle রূপ অথবা advice/order বুঝালে Should be + v3 হয়। বাক্যের অর্থ: দরজাটি বন্ধ কর।
The correct passive of ‘Smoke filled the room’ is-
The room was filled by smoke | The room was filled with smoke | The room had been filled with smoke | The room is filled by smoke
Fill verb-এর passive voice-এ preposition হিসেবে by-এর পরিবর্তে with বসে। তাই সঠিক passive বাক্যটি হলো: The room was filled with smoke.
The passive form of the sentence ‘Shoot the tiger’ is-
Let the tiger be shoot | Let the tiger be shot | Let the tiger be shooted | Let the tiger be shoted
Imperative sentence-কে passive করার নিয়ম: Let + object + be + v3 (past participle)। Shoot এর past participle হলো shot। সুতরাং সঠিক passive: Let the tiger be shot.
Identify the passive form of the following sentence: "Who has broken this jug?"
By whom has this jug been broken? | By whom has this jug broken? | By whom this jug has been broken? | Whom has this jug been broken?
Who যুক্ত Interrogative Sentence কে passive করার নিয়ম: By whom + auxiliary verb + Subject + v3 + ? সুতরাং, সঠিক উত্তর - By whom has this jug been broken?
Choose the passive structure- ‘His comment surprised me’.
I was surprised at his comment | I was surprised by his comment | I was surprised for his comment | I am surprised to his comment

Past Indefinite Tense যুক্ত Active Sentence কে Passive করার নিয়ম: Obj - কে Sub + was / were + verb এর p.p form + by / appropriate prep + sub - কে obj। Surprised-এর পর কোনো বিষয় বা মন্তব্যের ক্ষেত্রে 'at' বসে। সুতরাং সঠিক Passive form হলো - I was surprised at his comment.
What is the passive form of the sentence? ‘You have wasted much time’-
Much time was wasted by us | Much time has been wasted by you | Long time has wasted | Much time have been wasted
Present perfect tense-এর passive voice গঠন: Object কে Subject (Much time) + has been + verb এর past participle (wasted) + by + you। time হলো uncountable noun তাই singular verb has been বসবে।
Do not laugh at the lame man. The passive form of this sentence is-
Let not the lame man be laughed at. | You should not laugh at the lame man. | The lame man not be laughed at. | The lame man is not laughed at.

Do not/Don't দ্বারা শুরু হওয়া negative imperative বাক্যকে নিম্নের গঠনের দ্বারা Passive করা যায়: Let + not + Sub. (Active বাক্যের Obj- টি) + be + Main Verb- এর P.P. form বাক্যের বাকি শব্দ (যদি থাকে)। অতএব সঠিক passive: Let not the lame man be laughed at.
The correct passive structure of the sentence. ‘Let her sing a song’.
A song let be snag by her | A song let be sung by her | Let her a song be sung | Let a song be sung by her
Let + ব্যক্তিবাচক object যুক্ত active বাক্যকে passive বাক্যে রূপান্তরের নিয়ম: Let + object- subject + be + v3 + by + subject কে object। অর্থাৎ passive form: Let a song be sung by her.
Select the correct passive voice of “He did for me the unnecessary things.”-

The unnecessary things were done for me by him. | The unnecessary things was done by him for me. | The unnecessary things had been done for me by him. | The unnecessary things had to be done for me by him.

সাধারণত Active voice থেকে Passive voice এ রূপান্তর করার জন্য তিনটি কাজ করতে হয়। যথা— Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এর object এ রূপান্তরিত হয় এবং তার পূর্বে by বসে। Active voice এর object টি Passive voice এর subject এ পরিণত হয়। Subject ও Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb বসে এবং মূল verb এর past participle form (vvp) হয়। সুতরাং Passive voice এর Structure – Subject + Aux. verb + vvp + by + object.
Change the Voice ‘Who is calling me?
by whom am I called? | by whom I am called? | By whom am I being called? | Whom am I called by?

Present continuous tense-এ থাকা who Interrogative Sentence Passive করার নিয়ম: By whom + Auxiliary verb + sub + being + verb এর Past participle form + note of interrogation (?)। অর্থাৎ সঠিক Passive form-টি হচ্ছে- By whom am I being called?
The correct passive voice of the sentence "Who can avoid death?' is___
By whom death can be avoided? | Whom can death be avoided? | By whom can death be avoided? | Who can be avoided by death
Auxiliary verb এবং who যুক্ত active voice-কে passive করার নিয়ম: By whom + auxiliary + sub + be + v3 + ?। অর্থাৎ সঠিক Passive form- By whom can death be avoided?
The passive form of the sentence 'One must keep one's promises' is-
One's promises are kept. | One's promises must kept. | One's promises were kept. | One's promises must be kept.
Active voice-এ One, no one, everyone হলে passive voice-এ তা সাধারণত উঠে যায়। অর্থাৎ বাক্যটির ঠিক passive form হচ্ছে One's promises must be kept.
The passive form of "who helped him?" is-
By whom he was helped? | By whom was he helped? | Whom was he helped? | Whom did he help?
Past indefinite tense-এ থাকা who যুক্ত active voice-কে passive করার নিয়ম: By whom + was / were + sub + V3 + ? অর্থাৎ সঠিক passive form হচ্ছে By whom was he helped?
The passive form of ``Panic seized the writer'' is___
The writer was seized with panic | The writer was seized by panic | The writer was seized into panic | The writer was seized for panic
Passive voice এর ক্ষেত্রে seize, cover, decorate, fill, crowd of verb এর পরে by এর পরিবর্তে with বসে। অর্থাৎ সঠিক passive form: The writer was seized with panic.
Which one is the correct passive form of “He has done a great job”
A great job have been done by him. | A great job have been doing by him. | A great job has been done by him. | A great job has been doing by him.

Present perfect/Past perfect যুক্ত active voice- passive voice- কে রূপান্তর: Object-কে sub + have/has/had + been + v3 + by + subject- object অর্থাৎ সঠিক passive form: A great job has been done by him.
Which one is the correct passive voice in the following sentence? Who taught her grammar?
By whom she was taught grammar? | By whom was she taught grammar? | She was taught grammar by who? | Who was she taught grammar by?

Who যুক্ত Interrogative Sentence কে Passive করার নিয়ম: By whom + tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb + sub + মূল verb এর past participle form + object + ? সুতরাং সঠিক passive form টি- By whom was she taught grammar?
Which one of the following is the correct passive form of "One should keep one's promises"
Promises should be kept. | Promises will be kept. | promises can be kept. | promises would be kept.

সাধারণত One, none, nobody, everyone, everybody ইত্যাদি active voice এর subject হিসেবে থাকলে passive voice এ উঠে যায়। তাছাড়া modal verb (should, would, could) যুক্ত sentence-কে passive করার নিয়ম- obj কে subject + modal + be + v3, সুতরাং সঠিক Passive form: Promises should be kept.
‘Please don't disturb me'. Select the correct passive form of the sentence:
I should not be disturbed. | Let not I disturbed. | I might not be disturbed | I may not please be disturbed.
Voice change এর নিয়মানুযায়ী, প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির স্বাভাবিক passive form হচ্ছে: You are requested not to disturb me. কিন্তু অপশন বিচারে বাক্যটির Passive form: I should not be disturbed.
The passive form of the sentence The boy laughed at the lame man' is
The lame man was laughed by the boy | The lame man was laughed at by the boy | The lame was being laughed by the boy | The lame man was being laughed at by the boy
Past indefinite tense এ থাকা Active voice কে Passive করার নিয়ম: Sub + Was / were + V3 + preposition (at) + by + sub কে obj. বাক্যের অর্থঃ খোঁড়া লোক দেখে বালকটি বিদ্রূপ করেছিল।
The passive form of the sentence 'He wrote a letter to me' ....... is ......
A letter was written to me by him | A letter is written to my by him. | A letter had written to me by him. | A letter was written by me to him.
Past indefinite tense-এর passive voice গঠন: Object (A letter) + was + written + to me + by him। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর (ক)।
“I know you.” The correct passive form is-
you are known by me. | you are known to me | you are knowing to me. | you are known at me.
“I know you.” বাক্যটি passive করতে structure হবে obj কে sub + am/is/are + verb এর p.p + to (know এর ক্ষেত্রে) + sub কে obj।
Choose the correct passive form of, "Don't make a mistake about me."
Let a mistake be not made about me. | A mistake is not made about me. | I should not be made a mistake. | Let not a mistake be made about me
Negative imperative sentence-কে passive করার গঠন: Let not + object + be + past participle of verb + extension। সুতরাং সঠিক passive: Let not a mistake be made about me।
The passive form of the sentence: They are going to lock the gate at 7 O'Clock.
At 7 o'clock they are going locked the gate. | The gate at 7 o'clock be locked by them. | The gate is to going locked by them at 7 o'clock. | The gate is going to be locked at 7 o'clock.
'going to' যুক্ত বাক্যকে passive করার নিয়ম: Object কে Subject + be verb + going to + be + v3 + by + extension। সুতরাং The gate is going to be locked at 7 o'clock.
Identify the correct passive form: 'We called him a fool.'
He had been called a fool by us. | He was called a fool by us. | He has called a fool by us. | He has been called a fool by us.
Factitive verb (called) যুক্ত Past Indefinite Tense-এর passive করার নিয়ম: Object (him -> He) + was + called + factitive object (a fool) + by + us। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর (খ)।
The passive form of the sentence "Do the task as directed" is ----
let the task be done as directed. | let the task to be done as directed. | let the task is done as directed. | do the task to be directed.
Imperative sentence-এর passive গঠন: Let + object + be + v3 + extension। সুতরাং 'Do the task as directed' এর passive রূপ: let the task be done as directed.
The passive form of the sentence "Do the task as directed" is ----
let the task be done as directed. | let the task to be done as directed. | let the task is done as directed. | do the task to be directed.
Imperative sentence-এর passive গঠন: Let + object + be + v3 + as directed। অতএব সঠিক উত্তর (ক)।
The passive form of the sentence The boy laughed at the lame man' is
The lame man was laughed by the boy | The lame man was laughed at by the boy | The lame was being laughed by the boy | The lame man was being laughed at by the boy
Past indefinite tense এ থাকা Active voice কে Sub + Was / were + V3 + preposition (at) + by + sub কে obj। বাক্যের অর্থঃ খোঁড়া লোক দেখে বালকটি বিদ্রূপ করেছিল।
The passive form of the sentence "You should not scold the boy' is—
The boy should not be scold by you | The boy should not have been scold by you | The boy should not be scolded by you | The boy should not have been scolded by you.

Modal auxiliary verb যুক্ত active voice-কে passive করার নিয়মঃ object-কে subject + modal auxiliary verb + be + v3 + by + sub-কে obj। অতএব বাক্যটির passive form হচ্ছে: The boy should not be scolded by you.
Choose the correct passive form: I have lost my wallet.
My wallet had been lost. | My wallet has been lost | My wallet was lost. | My wallet is lost.
Present perfect tense-এর passive গঠন: Object কে Subject + has been + verb এর past participle। সুতরাং 'I have lost my wallet' এর passive form হলো: My wallet has been lost.
The passive form of: ‘We called him a fool.’ is-
He had been called a fool by us. | He was called a fool by us. | He has called a fool by us. | He has been called a fool by us.
Factitive verb যুক্ত Past Indefinite Tense-কে passive করার নিয়ম: Object (him -> He) + was + v3 (called) + factitive object (a fool) + by + us। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর (খ)।
Which one is the passive form of the sentence: 'Your behaviour pleased us.'
We were pleased by your behaviour. | We were being pleased by your behaviour. | We were pleased with your behaviour. | We were pleases by your behaviour.
Pleased-এর পর ব্যক্তিবাচক নয় এমন আচরণ/বিষয়ের ক্ষেত্রে preposition 'with' বা 'at' বসে (এখানে with your behaviour)। সুতরাং We were pleased with your behaviour.
Select the active structure
The tree has been uprooted. | The door should be kept closed. | My suggestion was not accepted. | I have lost my watch.
I have lost my watch হলো active voice। এর Passive রূপ হলো My watch has been lost. বাক্যের অর্থঃ আমার ঘড়িটি হারিয়ে গেছে। বাকি তিনটি অপশনই passive voice-এ রয়েছে।
Identify the correct passive form of: “Do not shut the door”.
The door is not to be shut. | The door may not be shut. | Let not the door be shut. | The door will not be shut.
Do not দিয়ে Imperative বাক্য শুরু হলে Passive বাক্য Let not দিয়ে শুরু হয়: Let not + object + be + v3। বাক্যের অর্থঃ দরজা বন্ধ করো না।
What is the passive voice of the sentence? ‘His conduct annoyed me’.
I was being annoyed by his conduct. | I was annoyed by his conduct. | I was annoyed at his conduct. | I had been annoyed on his conduct.
Annoy-এর পর আচরণের ক্ষেত্রে preposition 'at' বসে এবং ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে 'with' বসে। এখানে 'his conduct' আচরণ হওয়ায় 'annoyed at' বসবে।
‘He heard her sing’. The passive voice of the sentence is
She was heard to sing by him | She was heard sing by him. | She is heard to sing. | She was heard to be sung.
Verb with object + bare infinitive যুক্ত বাক্যের Passive করতে 'to + infinitive' ব্যবহার করতে হয়। বাক্যের অর্থঃ সে তার গান শুনেছিল। সুতরাং She was heard to sing by him.
Choose the passive sentence: "His comment surprised me'
I was surprised by his comment. | I was surprised at his comment. | I was surprised for his comment. | I was surprised to his comment.
Passive voice করার সময় Known এরপর 'to'; Shocked এরপর 'at'; Surprised এরপর 'at'; Pleased এরপর 'with'; Interested এরপর 'in' বসে। বাক্যের অর্থঃ তার মন্তব্য আমাকে অবাক করেছিল।
Identify the correct passive form: ‘Let me write a letter’.
Let a letter be written by me. | Let a letter is written by me. | Let a letter to write by me. | Let a letter write by me.
Imperative বাক্যের Passive voice নিচের মত করে হয়ঃ Let + Object-Subject + be + v(p.p) + by + extension। বাক্যের অর্থঃ আমার কর্তৃক একটি চিঠি লেখা হোক।
Which one is the correct passive voice of 'Don't do it' -
let not it be done | let it be not done | let it be done not | let it not be done
Object টি pronoun হওয়ায় সঠিক passive form হলো let it not be done. আর object টি noun হলে not টি noun-এর পূর্বে বসবে (যেমন: Let not the work be done)।
The passive form of the sentence "You made him cook rice" is —
He was made to cook rice. | He was made cook rice. | He is made to cook rice. | He had made to cook rice.
Causative verb যুক্ত বাক্যটির passive voice এর structure: Object কে Subject + was/were + causative verb-এর P.P + to + verb-এর base form। সুতরাং সঠিক passive form: He was made to cook rice.
The correct active form of the sentence 'Let it be done'. Is-
do it. | Let me do it. | I have done it. | It is done by me.
Imperative passive বাক্যের active voice-এর structure হলো: verb + object বা don't + verb-এর base form + obj। সুতরাং সঠিক active form হলো Do it।
The passive form of the sentence 'I have killed the bird' is —
The bird have been killed by me. | The bird has been being killed by me. | The bird has killed by me. | The bird has been killed by me.
Present perfect tense-এর passive voice-এর structure হলো ob কে sub + have/has + been + verb এর p.p + by + sub কে ob। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির passive form হলো The bird has been killed by me.
Select the passive voice of "His behaviour surprised me."
I was surprised at his behaviour. | I was surprise with his behaviour. | I was surprised to his behaviour. | I was surprised his behaviour.
Past Indefinite যুক্ত বাক্যটির passive voice-এর structure: ob কে sub + was/were + verb-এর p.p + at (something) + sub কে ob। সুতরাং বাক্যটির passive form হলো I was surprised at his behaviour।
Choose the correct passive form of the sentence I have written a letter.
A letter is being written by me. | A letter has being written by me. | A letter has been written by me. | A letter was being written by me.
Present perfect tense-এর passive voice-এর structure: Object (A letter) + has been + verb এর past participle (written) + by + me। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।
The correct passive form of the sentence 'I saw him fall from the tree' is—
He was seen by me to fall from the tree | The tree was seen to fall by me. | He was seen to fall from the tree by me | He was seen falling from the tree by me.

See somebody fall (bare infinitive) যুক্ত বাক্যের passive voice-এর structure: ob কে sub + was + verb-এর p.p + to + verb + অতিরিক্ত অংশ + by + sub কে ob। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির passive voice হলো: He was seen to fall from the tree by me. উল্লেখ্য fall-এর স্থলে falling থাকলে সঠিক উত্তর হতো He was seen falling from the tree by me.
‘Whom do you want?’ — the correct passive form of this sentence will be—
Whom is wanted by you? | Who is wanted by you? | By whom are you wanted? | By whom you are wanted?
Whom যুক্ত present indefinite tense-এর passive voice-এর structure হলো who + am/is/are + verb এর p.p + by + sub কে ob। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির passive form হলো Who is wanted by you?
Change the voice: ‘Please keep quiet’.
You are requested to keep quiet. | You are requested for keep quiet. | You are asked to keep quiet. | You are told to keep quiet.
Please যুক্ত imperative বাক্যের passive voice-এর structure হলো you are requested to + verb-এর base form + বাকি অংশ। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির passive voice: You are requested to keep quiet।
‘Please close the door’. The passive form of this sentences is:
Let the door be closed. | You are requested to close the door. | The door is to be closed. | I request you to close the door.
Please যুক্ত imperative বাক্যের passive voice এর structure: You are requested to + verb-এর base form + বাকি অংশ। সুতরাং সঠিক passive voice হলো You are requested to close the door।
‘Nobody believes a liar.’ The correct passive form of the above sentence is:
A liar is never believed by anyone. | A liar should not be believed by anybody. | A liar is not believed by anybody. | A liar is believed by nobody.
'Nobody যুক্ত বাক্যকে passive voice-এ রূপান্তরের structure: Ob কে sub + be verb + not + verb-এর p.p + by + anybody। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির passive form হলো A liar is not believed by anybody।
‘Tea is liked by common people’. This is an example of — .
active voice | passive voice | quasi-passive voice | double passive voice
Present Indefinite tense এর ক্ষেত্রে Passive বাক্যের structure হলো sub + be verb + verb এর p.p + by + ob। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্য Tea is liked by common people হলো passive বাক্যের উদাহরণ।
The correct passive form of the sentence. They elected him captain is — .
He is elected captian by them | He was elected captain by them | He has been elected captain by them | Captain is elected him by them.

Factitive object যুক্ত past indefinite tense-এর passive voice-এর structure: Pronominal obj-কে sub + was/ were + verb-এর p.p + factitive object + by + sub কে obj। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির passive form: He was elected captain by them.
‘Let me do the sum.' Passive voice of it is — .
Let the sum is to be done by me. | Let the sum done by me. | Let the sum being done by me. | Let the sum be done by me.
Let + ব্যক্তিবাচক object যুক্ত active বাক্যের passive গঠন: Let + object + be + verb3 + by + me। সুতরাং Let the sum be done by me.
What is the correct passive form of the sentence below?—'Do it.'
Let it be done. | It is ordered to be done. | Let us do it. | It is to be done.
'Do it' imperative বাক্যটির passive voice-এর structure হলো Let + ob + be + verb-এর P.P.। সুতরাং বাক্যটির সঠিক passive form হলো Let it be done।
Let him do the sum. The passive form of the sentence is:
Let the sum be done by him. | The sum done by him. | He finished the sum. | It was he who done the sum.
Let যুক্ত imperative বাক্যে passive গঠন: Let + object + be + verb3 + by + let পরবর্তী ব্যক্তিবাচক object (him)।
The passive form of the sentence 'I have killed the bird' is — .
The bird has killed by me | The bird has been killed by me | The bird have been killed by me | The bird has been being killed by me
Present perfect যুক্ত বাক্যকে passive করার নিয়ম হলো ob কে sub + have/ has + been + v-এর P.P + by + sub কে ob. সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির সঠিক passive form হলো: The bird has been killed by me.
The passive form of the sentence ‘His sudden death shocked me’ is:
I was shocked by his sudden death. | Note I was shocked to his sudden death. | I was shocked to know his sudden death. | I was shocked at his sudden death.
Passive বাক্যে shock (আঘাত দেওয়া) verb-এর by-এর পরিবর্তে at হয়। সুতরাং I was shocked at his sudden death.
The passive form of the sentence 'do not open the door' is—
let not the door be opened | let not the door open | let not the door be open | let not the door opened
Negative imperative sentence এর passive গঠন Let + not + object + be + verb এর past participle। সুতরাং let not the door be opened.
The correct passive form of the sentence ‘I know him.’ is-
He is known by me | He has been known by me | He is know with me | He is known to me
active: ‘I know him.’ passive: He is known to me. Structure: obj কে sub + am/is/are + verb এর p.p + to (know এর ক্ষেত্রে) + sub কে obj.
The passive form of ‘They have won the battle’ is—
The battle have won by them | The battle had been won by them | The battle was won by them | The battle has been won by them

'They have won the battle' এর Passive structure: obj এর subjective form + has been + verb এর past participle + by + sub এর objective form। মূল বইয়ের অপশন ও ব্যাখ্যা অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর: The battle has been won by them.
The correct passive form of the sentence ‘We don’t respect dishonest people is-
We are not respected by dishonest people | Dishonest people are not of our liking | Dishonest people are not respected by us | Dishonest people are not like us.
Structure: Object- কে subject + are not + verb-এর pp form + by + subject- কে object। অর্থাৎ passive form = Dishonest people are not respected by us.
The passive form of the sentence ‘He saw me do it’ is—
I was seen do it by him | I was seen to do it by him | I was seen doing it by him | I was seen to doing it by him

বাক্যটির passive হলো I was seen to do it by him কারণ প্রদত্ত বাক্যে bare infinitive ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে। Bare infinitive থাকলে passive এর ক্ষেত্রে to + verb বসবে আর ing যুক্ত verb থাকলে correct হতো (গ)।
‘Never tell a lie’ The passive form of this sentence is—
Let never be told a lie | Let not a lie never be told | Let a lie never be told | Let lie never be told
বাক্যটির passive form হলো Let a lie never be told. নিয়ম: Let + object + never + be + verb এর past participle।
Choose the correct passive form of ‘All his student like him.’
He is liked by all his students | He was liked by all his students | He has been liked by all his students | He is being liked by all his students
Present Indefinite tense-এর passive voice-এর structure: obj হবে sub + am/is/are + verb-এর pp + by + sub হবে obj। সঠিক হবে (ক)।
‘He helped me do it’. The passive voice of the sentence is—
It was done by him to help me | I was helped by him to do it | It was helped me by him to do it | I was helped by him do it

Help + object + verb এর base form যুক্ত বাক্যের passive voice এর structure: object-কে subject + tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb-এর p.p + by + subject-কে object + to + verb + বাকি অংশ। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর I was helped by him to do it.
Choose the correct expression:
She was born in 1985 | She has born in 1985 | She has been born in 1985 | She was borne in 1985
কেউ জন্মগ্রহণ করলে তার কালকে সাধারণত past tense ধরা হয় এবং তা passive voice এ হয়। যেহেতু bear এর past participle হলো born। তাই উত্তর হবে 'She was born in 1985'।
He was helping me. The correct passive form is :
I was helped by him | I had been hepled by him | I have been helped by him | I was being helped by him.

গঠনঃ Subject (Active voice এর Object টির Subjective form) + was being/ were being + মূল verb এর past participle + by + Object (Subject এর Objective form)। সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে- I was being helped by him.
‘Whom did she accuse?’ Choose the right passive voice.
Who was accused by her? | Who had been accused by her? | Who was being accused by her? | Who has been accused by her?

Interrogative বাক্যের শুরুতে Whom থাকলে এর পরিবর্তে Passive বাক্যের শুরুতে Who বসে। গঠনঃ প্রথমে Who (Whom এর পরিবর্তে) + Verb 'to be' (tense অনুসারে) + বাক্যের মূল Verb এর Past Participle form + বাক্যের বাকি শব্দ + by + Object + ?
‘A freedom fighter is always honoured by his country people.’ The passive form of the sentence—

People of a country honours their freedom fighters always. | People of a country always honour their freedom fighters. | His country people honour always their freedom fighters. | People honour their freedom fighters.
বাক্যটি passive form দেওয়া আছে, অপশনগুলো থেকে সঠিক active form বের করতে হবে: People of a country always honour their freedom fighters.
“The work is done by Medha”—This is an example of—
active voice | passive voice | quasi-passive voice | not any voice which are mentioned
বাক্যটিতে be verb (is) + verb-এর past participle (done) + by + object থাকায় এটি passive voice।
What is the passive form of ‘Do it’.
It is done by you | Let it be done | Let done it by you | Let be it done (by you)
Imperative sentence এ Passive করার নিয়ম Let + object + be + past participle verb।
The passive form of the sentence. "We made her recite a poem'—
a poem was made recite by her | She was made to recite a poem | She was made recited a poem | a poem was made to be recited
Active: We made her recite a poem -> Passive: She was made to recite a poem. Make, help, see এই verb গুলো active-এ bare infinitive গ্রহণ করলেও passive-এ infinitive "to" বসে।
Which one is the passive form of the sentence — "I knew him"?
He is known to me | He was known by me | He was known to me | He was known with me
Past indefinite tense এবং know verb-এর সাথে preposition 'to' বসে: He was known to me.
‘Let him be told to go' change the voice
Go | Let you go | You go | Tell him to go
Let দ্বারা passive sentence শুরু হলে সাধারণত Imperative sentence কে নির্দেশ করে। প্রশ্নোক্ত passive sentence-এ মূল verb 'told' থাকায় 'Tell him to go' হচ্ছে সঠিক Active voice।
What is the passive form of the sentence— ‘Give the order’?
Let the order to give | Let the order to given | Let the order be given | Let the order give
Verb দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া Imperative Sentence কে active voice থেকে Passive voice এর রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম- Let + Active voice-এর Object + be + verb- এর past participle form.
The house is building. The passive form is
A house is being built by us. | The masons are building the house | It is the house which is being built. | The house is being built.
Quasi-passive verb যে বাক্যে থাকে তার active ও passive উভয় form এ subject একই থাকে আর complement ছাড়া quasi-passive-এর নিয়ম হচ্ছে subject + be (tense ও subject অনুসারে) + v3।
Passive form of the sentence—"One should keep one's promises."
Promises should be kept | You shall keep your promise | Promises should be kept at one's own | It is promise and it should be kept
One + should যুক্ত sentence-কে passive করার নিয়ম হচ্ছে: প্রথমে object-টি subject রূপে বসবে + should be + verb-এর past participle form। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর (ক)।
Which is the correct passive form of the sentence?"He is writing a letter"
A letter is written by him | A letter was written by him | A letter was being written by him | A letter is being written by him
Present Continuous Tense-এর passive করার নিয়ম: Object-কে subject + am/is/are being + verb-এর past participle + by + subject-কে object।
Passive form of “Who has done the work?” is-
Whom has done the work by? | Who has been done the work? | By whom has been done the work? | By whom has the work been done?

Present Perfect Tense-এর 'Who' সম্বলিত Interrogative sentence-এর passive করার নিয়মঃ By whom + has/have + active voice-এর object (subject হিসেবে) + been + active voice-এর verb-এর Past Participle form + extension। এ নিয়মানুসারে (ঘ)-ই সঠিক।
‘You must do the work.’ Change the sentence in passive voice.
The work will be done by you. | The work must be done by you. | The work has been done by you. | You will do the work.
Voice- এর নিয়মানুসারে voice পরিবর্তনের সময় shall, will, should, would, can, could, may, might এবং must- এর পর be ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং এরপর verb- এর Past participle হয়। সুতরাং (খ) সবদিক থেকে সঠিক।
What is the passive voice of “Who did this?”
By whom was this done? | Who has done this? | By whom this has been done? | Whom did this?

Voice- এর নিয়মানুসারে প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যটি who দ্বারা শুরু হলে passive voice করার সময় who এর পরিবর্তে By whom ব্যবহৃত হয় + মূল verb past tense- এর হওয়ায় (এখানে did মূল verb) was ব্যবহৃত হয় + object টি subject হয় (এখানে this) + মূল verb- এর past participle হয়।
What is the active voice of “The gate was opened by the peon.”
The peon opened the gate. | The peon had opened the gate. | The peon has opened the gate. | The peon opens the gate.

Voice- এর নিয়মানুসারে Passive voice কে Active voice- এ রূপান্তর করার সময় শুরুতে Agent অর্থাৎ by/at/with/in/to ইত্যাদির পরে অবস্থানকারী object টি subject হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয় + passive voice এ ব্যবহৃত সাহায্যকারী verb উঠে গিয়ে মূল verb টি Tense, number ও person অনুসারে ব্যবহৃত হয় + subject টি object রূপে ব্যবহৃত হয়।
Which one is the correct passive form of the sentence-----‘Open the door’?
The door is opened | The door should be opened | Let the door be opened | Let me open the door

Verb দ্বারা শুরু হওয়া Imperative Sentence-এর active form থেকে passive করার নিয়ম হলো: প্রথমে Let + object + be + verb-এর past participle form হয়। যেমন- Open the door-এর passive form হচ্ছে Let the door be opened. সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।
The passive form of "Who has done the work?" is----------------
By whom has the work been done? | Who has been done the work? | By whom has been done the work? | Whom has done the work by?
Who যুক্ত Present Perfect Tense-কে passive করার নিয়ম: By whom + has/have + obj (subject রূপে) + been + v3 + ?। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর (ক)।
My uncle looks after me বাক্যের সঠিক passive from-
I am looked after by my uncle | I was looked after by my uncle | I am look after by my uncle | I am being looked after by my uncle

Active voice টি present indefinite tense হলে, passive voice-এর ক্ষেত্রেও present indefinite tense হবে। passive voice এর ক্ষেত্রে be verb (am/is/are)-এর পর verb-এর past participle বসে এবং preposition (after) সাথে থাকে। উত্তর (ক)।
Some children were helping the wounded man এর Passive form হবে
The wounded man was being helped by some children | The wounded man was helped by some children | The wounded man was helping some children | The wounded man was to be helped by some children
Active voice-এর Sentence টি Continuous tense এ থাকলে passive voice এর ক্ষেত্রেও তার continuous tense হবে (was/were being + v3)। তাই (খ), (গ) ও (ঘ) ভুল। সঠিক উত্তর (ক)।
Which one is the correct passive form?
He should have been helped by you | He ought to have been helped by you | He would have been helped by you | He got to have been helped by you
Modal perfect (should have + v3)-এর passive হলো should have been + v3। সঠিক passive: He should have been helped by you. যার active form: You should have helped him. সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর (ক)।
The passive form of "Who has done the work?" is-------------
By whom has the work been done? | Who has been done the work? | By whom has been done the work? | Whom has done the work by?

Who যুক্ত interrogative sentence-এর active voice-কে passive voice করার নিয়ম: who এর পরিবর্তে by whom বসে + auxiliary verb বসে + object টি subject হয় + two - part auxiliary verb-এর ক্ষেত্রে দ্বিতীয় part বসে (যেমন- has been-এর ক্ষেত্রে) + মূল verb এর past participle বসে + প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে। সুতরাং এক্ষেত্রে সঠিক উত্তরটি হল 'ক'।
What is the passive form of ‘Do it’?
It is done by you | Let it be done | Let done it by you | Let it by done (by you)
Active voice: Do it. Passive voice: Let it be done. নিয়ম: Let + object + be + verb এর past participle form.
The active form of ‘Let it be done’ is-
Let me do it | I have done it | Do it | It is done by me
Verb দ্বারা আরম্ভ হওয়া Imperative sentence কে passive করার নিয়ম হলো Let + object + be + verb এর past participle বসে। অতএব সঠিক active হলো ‘Do it’।
Which one is the correct passive form?
He ought to have been helped by you. | He would have been helped by you. | He should have been helped by you. | He got to have been helped by you.

Active voice: You will have helped me. Passive voice: He would have been helped by you.. যা এই নিয়মানুযায়ী হবে: Subject (Active voice এর Object টির Subjective form) + shall have been/ will have been + মূল verb past participle + by + Object (Subject এর Objective form) অতএব সঠিক উত্তর ‘খ’।
Select the correct sentence — .
The matter was informed of the police. | The matter had been informed of the police. | The police was informed of the matter. | The matter was informed to the police.
Inform someone of something অর্থ কাউকে কোনো কিছু জানানো। আর বাক্যটি passive structure-এ হওয়ায় সঠিক বাক্য The police was informed of the matter।
Narration - উক্তি পরিবর্তন (Direct & Indirect)
Change the narration: She asked me, “Are you happy with your life?”
She asked me if I am happy with my life. | She asked me if I was happy with my life. | She asked me if I had been happy with my life. | She asked me if I were happy with my life.

Interrogative বাক্যকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের ক্ষেত্রে Reporting verb টি ask, demand of, want to know ইত্যাদিতে পরিণত হয়। Reported speech টি Auxiliary verb দ্বারা শুরু হলে linker হিসেবে if বা whether বসে এবং বাক্যটি assertive বাক্যে পরিণত হয় (Past Indefinite: was)।
The teacher said, “The earth-round the sun”?
moves | moved | has moved | will move
Reported speech কোনো চিরন্তন সত্য (Universal Truth) বা বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য প্রকাশ করলে Indirect Narration এ Reported speech এর Tense এর কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না (Present Indefinite tense-ই বহাল থাকে)।
Choose the correct indirect speech: She said to me, “Are you happy in your new job?”
She asked me if I had been happy in my new job. | She asked me if I was happy in my new job. | She asked me if I have been happy in my new job. | She asked me if I whether I am happy in my new job.

Interrogative sentence-কে indirect করার নিয়ম: Reporting verb 'said to' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে 'asked' হয় + object + if + subject (I) + verb (was) + extension। সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্য: She asked me if I was happy in my new job.
The salesman said, “Thank you Sir”. The correct form of indirect speech is-
The salesman thanked his customer. | The salesman respectfully thanked the person spoken to. | The salesman said that thank you sir. | The salesman addressed the customer ‘sir’ and thanked him.
Direct speech এ "Thank you" থাকলে Indirect করার সাধারণ নিয়ম: Subject + thanked + person spoken to (customer)। সুতরাং The salesman thanked his customer।
Choose the correct indirect speech: She said to me, “Are you happy in your new job”?
She asked me if I was happy in my new job. | She asked me if I had been happy in my new job. | She asked me if I have been happy in my new job. | She asked me whether I am happy in my new job.
Interrogative বাক্যকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের ক্ষেত্রে Reporting verb টি ask হয়, linker 'if' বসে এবং tense পরিবর্তিত হয়ে Past Indefinite হয়: She asked me if I was happy in my new job.
Change narration: She said to me, “Do you know my father?”
She asked me if I did know her father. | She asked me if I know her father. | She asked me if her father is known to me. | She asked me if I knew her father.
Do/does দিয়ে interrogative বাক্য শুরু হলে indirect-এ if + subject + past form of verb (knew) + extension বসে। সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্য: She asked me if I knew her father.
The indirect form of- He said, “Let me have some milk.”-
He asked to have dome milk | He wished that he might have dome milk | He wanted to have dome milk | He prayed to have dome milk
Indirect speech-এ পরিবর্তিত করতে হলে, ইচ্ছা প্রকাশ বোঝাতে say verb-এর স্থলে 'wish' বসবে এবং পরবর্তী বাক্যাংশটি that + subject + might + v1 - structure অনুসরণ করবে।
Choose the indirect speech of the sentence: She said to him, “Thank you”
She told him to thank you | She thanked him | She thanked you | She said to him to thank you
Narration এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী "Thank you" এর ক্ষেত্রে Reporting verb এর subject + thanked + subject এর object form এই নিয়মে indirect করতে হয়। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর: She thanked him.
Change the form of narration: The teacher said ``Honesty is the best policy.''

The teacher said that Honesty is the best policy. | The teacher said that Honesty was the best policy. | The teacher said that Honesty had been the best policy. | The teacher said that Honesty should be the best policy.
Reported speech কোনো চিরন্তন সত্য বা নীতিবাক্য প্রকাশ করলে Indirect Narration এ Reported speech এর Tense এর কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না। শুধু linker হিসেবে 'that' যুক্ত হয়।
He said to her, “what a cold day”! Select the correct indirect speech.
He told her that it was a cold day | He exclaims that it was a cold day | He exclaims sorrowfully that it was a cold day | He exclaimed that it was a very cold day
What যুক্ত exclamatory sentence-কে indirect-এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: sub + exclaimed + that + it + was/were + a very + বাকি অংশ। অর্থাৎ সঠিক indirect form- He exclaimed that it was a very cold day.
The teacher said to me, "Why were you absent?" The indirect speech of the sentence above is___.
The teacher asked me why I was absent. | The teacher asked me why I had been absent. | The teacher asked me why I have been absent. | The teacher wanted to know why I was absent.

Interrogative Sentence-এ থাকা Wh-question direct থেকে indirect করার নিয়ম: sub + asked + obj + wh-word + assertive গঠন। Past indefinite tense (were) পরিবর্তিত হয়ে past perfect (had been) হয়: The teacher asked me why I had been absent.
He said to me "what a nice man you are, sir" The correct indirect speech of this sentence is;

He asked me what a nice man I was. | Respectfully he exclaimed with joy that I was a very nice man. | Addressing me as sir, he respectfully exclaimed with joy that I was a very nice man. | He asked me what a nice man I was.

Direct speech-এ Sir থাকলে Indirect speech-এ 'Addressing as sir' বা 'respectfully' ব্যবহার করতে হয়। Exclamatory বাক্যকে assertive-এ পরিবর্তন করে: Addressing me as sir, he respectfully exclaimed with joy that I was a very nice man.
Find out the correct indirect speech of the following sentence. He said to me, "Thank you"
He thanked me | He had thanked me | He told me that thank you | He wished thank to me
Direct speech এ Thank you, thanks, congratulations, welcome ইত্যাদি থাকলে Indirect speech-এ Said এর পরিবর্তে Thanked, congratulated, welcomed বসে। বাক্যের অর্থ: সে আমাকে ধন্যবাদ দিল।
Change the narration: She said to me, “What are you doing?”
She asked me what I am doing | She asked me what I was doing. | She asked me what was I doing | She asked me what had I been doing.

Present continuous tense-এ থাকা interrogative sentence যুক্ত reported speech-কে direct থেকে indirect speech-এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: Sub + asked + obj + wh-word + sub + past continuous tense: She asked me what I was doing.
Which one is the correct sentence? He said, "I shall go home tomorrow,"
He said that he would go home the next day | He said that he would go home tomorrow. | He said that he would have gone home the next day | He said that he should go home tomorrow

Future indefinite tense-এ থাকা direct speech-কে indirect করার নিয়ম: Sub + reporting verb + that + sub + would + v1 + বাকী অংশ + Tomorrow এর পরিবর্তে the next day/the following day। সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্যটি হলো- He said that he would go home the next day.
Find the correct indirect speech of The teacher said to Alam, "work regularly.
The teacher advised Alam to work regularly. | The teacher said to Alam to work regularly. | The teacher told to Alam to working regularly. | The teacher said Alam to work regularly.

Direct speech এর reported speech-টি imperative sentence-এ থাকলে এবং তা দ্বারা উপদেশ বুঝালে indirect: subject + advise + obj + to + reported speech-এর মূল verb থেকে বাকি অংশ: The teacher advised Alam to work regularly.
Choose the correct indirect speech of the sentence My friend said to me, "Let's leave the place."

My friend proposed to me that they should leave the place | My friend wished me that we might leave the place | My friend suggested that I should leave the place | My friend proposed to me that we should leave the place

Let's (let us) দ্বারা প্রস্তাব বুঝালে Reporting verb টি propose/suggest-এ রূপান্তরিত হয় এবং that + we/they should + verb-এর base form বসে। এখানে me থাকায় we should হবে: My friend proposed to me that we should leave the place.
He said to me. "Do you know me?" – Identify the correct indirect speech:
He asked me if I know him. | He asked do I know him. | He asked me if I knew him. | He asked me did I know him.

Interrogative বাক্যকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের ক্ষেত্রে Reporting verb টি ask হয়, linker হিসেবে if বসে, এবং Present Indefinite tense পরিবর্তিত হয়ে Past Indefinite (knew) হয়: He asked me if I knew him.
Identify the correct indirect– Shojib said, “I know this boy”
Shojib said that he knew the boy. | Shojib said that he knew this boy. | Shojib said that he knew that boy. | Shojib said that he knows this boy.
Direct speech-এ 'this' থাকলে indirect speech-এ তা 'that'-এ রূপান্তরিত হয় এবং know verb-এর past form 'knew' হয়: Shojib said that he knew that boy.
The indirect speech of, He said, “You liar'. Is
He said me a liar. | He called me liar. | He said me to go to a liar. | He called me a liar.
বাক্যের অর্থঃ সে বলল, তুমি মিথ্যাবাদী। কাউকে কোনো নামে সম্বোধন বা আখ্যা দিলে Indirect-এ 'He called me a liar' হয়।
Find out the correct sentence in indirect speech. He said to me, “What are you doing?”
He said what was to do | He said about my doing | He said to me what I am doing | He asked me what I was doing
Direct speech এ Present continuous tense থাকলে Indirect speech এ তা Past continuous tense হয়ে যায়: He asked me what I was doing।
Choose the indirect speech of the sentence. He said to me "Thank you"
He thanks you | He thanked you | He thanks me | He thanked me.
Reporting verb past tense-এ থাকায় বাক্যটির indirect narration হবে He thanked me।
What will be the indirect form of the sentence following sentence? He said ‘I am well’
He said that I was well. | He said that he is well. | He said that he was well. | He said that I am well.
Reporting verb past tense-এ থাকায় reported speech-এর present indefinite tense পরিবর্তিত হয়ে past indefinite tense-এ রূপান্তরিত হবে: He said that he was well।
He said, "I shall go to office". Indirect form is--
He said that he shall go to office. | He said that he would go to office. | He said that he will go to office. | He said that he should go to office.
Reported speech এ future indefinite থাকলে shall বা will এর স্থলে would ব্যবহৃত হবে। আর subject he হওয়ায়: He said that he would go to office।
The teacher said, “Thank you, boys”. The indirect narration of the sentence is –
The teacher said that thank, you my boys. | The teacher told the boys and thanked them. | The boys were thanked by the teacher. | The teacher thanked the boys.
কোনো বাক্যে Thank you থাকলে Reporting verb এ Said এর পরিবর্তে Thanked বসে: The teacher thanked the boys।
The old man said, “Curse the flood”. The indirect form of the sentence is
The old man said that the flood be cursed | The old man was cursing the flood. | The old man told that the flood is cursed. | The old man cursed the flood.
বাক্যের অর্থঃ বৃদ্ধ লোকটি বন্যাকে অভিশাপ দিল। সুতরাং সঠিক Indirect form: The old man cursed the flood.
Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'Man is mortal'.
He said man is mortal. | He total that man had been mortal. | He said that man was mortal. | He said that man is mortal.
Reported speech-এ চিরন্তন সত্য বাক্য থাকলে indirect speech-এ reported speech-এর verb-এর কোনো রূপ পরিবর্তন হয় না। সুতরাং He said that man is mortal।
The indirect speech of the sentence: Sally said to me, 'Please get me a drink' is:
Sally told me to get a drink for her. | Sally asked me to get her a drink. | Sally told me to get a drink. | Sally inquired me to have a drink for her.
Reported speech দ্বারা অনুরোধ বুঝালে said-এর পরিবর্তে asked বা requested বসে + Object + to + Verb + বাক্যের বাকি অংশ: Sally asked me to get her a drink.
Choose the correct indirect form of the following sentence: He said to me, 'I don't believe you'.
He said that he didn't believe you | He said he hadn't believe me. | He told me that he didn't believe me. | He told me he wouldn't believe me.
He said to me পরিবর্তিত হয়ে He told me that হবে, I পরিবর্তিত হয়ে he, don't believe পরিবর্তিত হয়ে didn't believe এবং you পরিবর্তিত হয়ে me হবে: He told me that he didn't believe me.
Find the correct indirect speech. He said, “I am well”
He said that I am well | He said that I was well | He said that he was well | He said that he is well
Reporting verb past tense এ হলে আর reported speech এর that clause-টি simple present tense থেকে simple past tense-এ রূপান্তরিত হবে: He said that he was well.
I said to him, “Is he a Doctor?” Turn the sentence into indirect speech.
I said to him that he was a doctor | I said to him whether he is a doctor | I asked him whether he is a doctor | I asked him whether he was a doctor
Reporting verb টি past tense এ হলে আর reported speech টি interrogative হলে if বা whether বসবে আর reported speech এর verb পরিবর্তন হয়ে past tense হবে: I asked him whether he was a doctor।
Choose the right indirect Speech: ‘What are you doing? asked the teacher.
The teacher asked what he was doing | The teacher asked what was he doing | The teacher asked what is he doing | The teacher asked what are you doing.

Wh যুক্ত বাক্যটিকে indirect narration করার structure: Sub + asked + what + sub + was doing (reporting verb past হলে reported verb টি present continuous থেকে past continuous হয় এবং বাক্যটি assertive গঠন পায়)।
Choose the direct speech of the sentence: She told me to stand up.
She said, "Do stand up." | She said to me, "Stand up." | She told, "Stand up." | She said me, "Stand up."
Direct Narration এ Reported speech টি Imperative sentence হলে Imperative verb টি দ্বারা আদেশ, অনুরোধ ইত্যাদি করা হয়। She told me to stand up-এর direct form: She said to me, "Stand up."
‘Don't waste time’, the teacher said to the students. The indirect form of the speech—

The teacher forbade the students not to waste time | The teacher advised the students not to waste time | The teacher advised the students to not waste time | The teacher ordered the students don't waste time
Negative imperative-এ forbade বসলে আর 'not' বসে না। কিন্তু advised বসলে 'not to waste time' বসে। সুতরাং (খ) সঠিক।
He said, "Good morning, Mr. Kamal". (Change the speech)
He wished Mr. Kamal good morning | He has wished Mr. Kamal good monring | He said Mr. Kamal good morning | He told Mr. Kamal good morning
Direct speech-এ Good morning থাকলে indirect করার নিয়ম: Reporting verb-এর sub + wished + object + good morning: He wished Mr. Kamal good morning.
Rony said, ‘I must write a letter.’ The indirect form of the aforesaid sentence is—
Rony said that I must write a letter | Rony said that he must write a letter | Rony said that he had to write a letter | Rony said that he have to write a letter
Reporting verb past tense-এ থাকলে Direct speech-এর 'must' সাধারণ বাধ্যবাধকতা বুঝালে indirect-এ 'had to'-তে পরিবর্তিত হয়: Rony said that he had to write a letter।
He said to me, "Thank you'.
He thanked me | He had thanked me | He told me that thank you | He wished thank to me
Narration-এর নিয়মে: Thank you-এর জন্য Reporting verb-এর subject + thanked + object: He thanked me.
Select the correct change of speech. “What do you want?” She asked him.
She asked him what he wanted. | She asked him what he wants. | She asks him what he wants. | She wanted him.
Wh-word দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যে Conjunction 'if' বসে না, Wh-word টিই বসে এবং Present Indefinite tense পরিবর্তিত হয়ে Past Indefinite (wanted) হয়: She asked him what he wanted.
Choose the direct speech of the sentence: She told us to hurry up.
She said, ‘Do hurry up’. | She said to us, `Hurry up’ | She told, `Hurry up’ | She said us, `Hurry up’
'Tell' reporting verb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হতে চাইলে সাধারণত 'say to' হয় এবং imperative speech direct-এ মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু হয়: She said to us, `Hurry up’।
Choose the appropriate indirect speech of the following: He said to me, "what do you want?"
He said to me what I want | He told me what I wanted | He asked me what I want | He asked me what I wanted
প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যের ক্ষেত্রে said-এর পরিবর্তে asked বসে এবং পরের অংশে Present Indefinite থাকলে Past Indefinite হয়: He asked me what I wanted.
She said, “Let me come in.” Which of the following is correct indirect form of speech?
She paid that she come in | She requested that she may come in | She requested that she may be allowed to come in | She requested that she might come in

Imperative Sentence- এ Let- এর পর us থাকলে প্রস্তাব বোঝায় এবং Let- এর পর me/him/them ইত্যাদি থাকলে অনুমতি বা অনুরোধ বোঝায়। এক্ষেত্রে Narration পরিবর্তনের সময় subject + requested + that + subject + might + come in বসে: She requested that she might come in.
He said to me, "Do you like music?" The indirect form of this sentence is ----------
He said if I like music | He asked me do I like music | He asked to me if I like music | He asked me if I liked music

Auxiliary verb যুক্ত interrogative sentence এর direct speech কে indirect করার নিয়ম: Subject + ask + object + if / whether + reported speech এর subject + tense অনুযায়ী verb (liked) + বাকি অংশ। সুতরাং He asked me if I liked music.
She said to him, “I will call you as soon as possible”.--- Which of the following is correct indirect form of speech?

She told that she will call him as soon as possible | She told him she called him as soon as possible | She told him that she would call him as soon as possible | She told him she would call him as soon as possible
Direct speech-এ will থাকলে indirect speech-এ would হয় এবং linker হিসেবে that বসে: She told him that she would call him as soon as possible।
“Come in, my friend” said I বাক্যের সঠিক indirect speech:

Addressing him as my friend, I told him to go in | Addressing him as my friend, he said him to go in | Addressing him as my friend, I have said him to go in | Addressing him as my friend, I asked him to go in
Direct speech-এর said, indirect speech-এ told-এ রূপান্তরিত হয় এবং come in পরিবর্তিত হয়ে go in হয়। Addressing him as my friend, I told him to go in.
He said, “What a pity!” বাক্যের Indirect speech
He explained that it was a great pity. | He said that it was a great pity. | He explained that it is great pity. | He explained that it is a great pity.
Exclamatory sentence-এর narration-এর ক্ষেত্রে said-এর পরিবর্তে exclaim (প্রশ্নে explain মুদ্রিত) বসে এবং what দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হলে noun-এর পূর্বে great বসে। উত্তর (ক)।
Aref told us that he had waited an hour বাক্যটির direct speech হবে
Aref said to us, ‘I have been waiting an hour.’ | Aref said to us, ‘I waited an hour.’ | Aref said to us, ‘I had to wait an hour.’ | Aref said to us, ‘I have waited an hour.’
Direct speech-এর Reported speech present perfect tense হলে indirect speech এ তা past perfect tense হয়: Aref said to us, ‘I have waited an hour.’
He said, “Good morning Mr. Kamal” (Change the Speech)
He said Mr. Kamal good morning | He has wished Mr. Kamal good morning | He wished Mr. Kamal good morning | He told Mr. Kamal good morning
Direct speech-এ Good morning থাকলে indirect করার নিয়ম: Reporting verb-এর sub + wished + object + good morning: He wished Mr. Kamal good morning.
He said to me, "Do you like music?" The indirect form of this sentence is ----------
He said if I like music | He asked me do I like music | He asked to me if I like music | He asked me if I liked music
Auxiliary verb যুক্ত interrogative sentence এর direct speech কে indirect করার নিয়ম: Subject + ask + object + if / whether + reported speech এর subject + tense অনুযায়ী verb (liked) + বাকি অংশ।
Anis said, ‘I must write a letter.’ The indirect narration of this sentence is-
Anis said he must write a letter | Anis said that he must write a letter | Anis said he had to write a letter | Anis said that he had to write a letter
Reporting Verb- টি Past Tense- এ থাকলে Indirect Narration- এ Direct Speech- এর Verb অনুরূপ Past Tense- এ পরিবর্তিত হবে। Must পরিবর্তিত হয়ে had to হয়: Anis said that he had to write a letter.
He said, “Good morning, Mr. Kamal.” (Change the speech)-
He wished Mr. Kamal good morning. | He has wished Mr. Kamal good morning. | He said Mr. Kamal good morning. | He told Mr. Kamal good morning.
Direct speech-এ Good morning থাকলে indirect-এ wished বসে: He wished Mr. Kamal good morning.
Kalam says that he did not go. (Change the speech)-
Kalam says, ‘He did not go’ | Kalam says, ‘I do not go’ | Kalam says, ‘I have not gone’ | Kalam says, ‘I did not go’
Reporting verb present tense (says)-এ থাকলে reported speech-এর tense অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। Indirect-এর he did not go এর direct speech হবে 'I did not go': Kalam says, ‘I did not go’।
Identify the correct sentences:

He has said to me that I will go but you will stay there in Dhaka. | He has told me that he will go but I will stay here in Dhaka. | He has told me that I would go but you would stay there in Dhaka. | He has told me that he would go but I would stay here in Dhaka.

Reporting verb টি present perfect tense এবং Direct speech টি Future indefinite tense হলে direct speech কে indirect করার নিয়ম: sub + has said/told + that + sub + will + v + obj (tense-এর পরিবর্তন হয় না)। সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্য (b)।
He told me that he _____ in Spain the previous year.
has been working | had worked | had been worked | had been working

Past indefinite tense-এ থাকা Assertive sentence-কে direct থেকে indirect করার নিয়ম: Sub + reporting verb + that + sub + past perfect tense। সাধারণত Direct বাক্যে past indefinite tense থাকলে indirect-এ past perfect tense হয়: He told me that he had worked in Spain the previous year.
Put the correct verb in the gap: He said that he---not come to the meeting room.
will | shall | would | should
Direct narration এর reporting verb past tense এ থাকলে indirect করার সময় reported speech এর will-এর পরিবর্তে would হয়। সঠিক হবে (গ) would।
Meaning of Words - শব্দার্থ ও প্রায় সমোচ্চারিত শব্দ
What is meant by the word 'ditto'?
that is | for example | as before | and the others
'Ditto' শব্দের মানে হলো 'আগের মতো' বা 'যেমন আগে ছিল' (as before)।
'Handy' means-
comfortable | useful | necessary | convenient
Handy অর্থ (বস্তু সম্পর্কে) সুবিধাজনক বা দরকারী যার সমার্থক হলো Useful। কিন্তু comfortable (স্বচ্ছন্দ); necessary (প্রয়োজনীয়); convenient (সুবিধাজনক)।
'Plagiarism' means-
the act of using someone else's idea as one's own. | the act of planning everything beforehand. | the act of playing a musical instrument. | the art of dealing with forgery.
Plagiarism (চৌর্যবৃত্তি): একজনের ধারণা বা রচনাকে নিজের বলে চালিয়ে দেয়া (the act of using someone else's idea as one's own)।
The word 'sibling' means-
a brother | a sister | a brother or sister | a brother and a sister
Sibling শব্দটির বাংলা অর্থ একই পিতামাতার সন্তান; ভাই বা বোন। সুতরাং sibling অর্থ a brother or sister।
'A controversial call by the referee sparked mayhem among the fans.' The word 'mayhem' in the sentence means-
rowdy disorder | extreme excitement | exuberant joy | a storm of protest

"A controversial call by the referee sparked mayhem among the fans" বাক্যে 'mayhem' এর মানে হলো 'অশান্তি বা বিশৃঙ্খলা'। rowdy disorder = অশান্তি বা বিশৃঙ্খলা; extreme excitement = চরম উত্তেজনা; exuberant joy = অত্যধিক আনন্দ; a storm of protest = প্রতিবাদের ঝড়।
Misanthropist means-
One who never misses a trick | A person of narrow views | One who hates mankind | One who believes that Allah is everywhere

Misanthropist = মানবজাতির প্রতি ঘৃণা পোষণকারী। One who never misses a trick = এমন ব্যক্তি যে কখনও সুযোগ হাতছাড়া করে না; A person of narrow views = সংকীর্ণমনা ব্যক্তি; One who hates mankind = যে মানবজাতিকে ঘৃণা করে।
'Nepotism' means-
Terrorism | Despotism | Hooliganism | Favouritism
Nepotism = স্বজনপ্রীতি বা পক্ষপাতিত্ব (Favouritism)। Terrorism = সন্ত্রাসবাদ; Despotism = একনায়কতন্ত্র; Hooliganism = গুণ্ডামি বা আইন অমান্য করে হট্টগোল সৃষ্টি।
Which of the following pairs of words best describe the meaning of arable?
bad for farming | good for building on | good for farming | sold for farming
Arable (adjective): fit for or cultivated by plowing; suitable for producing crops (কৃষিকাজের উপযোগী বা চাষযোগ্য)। অর্থাৎ good for farming।
'Hardly' means-
always | almost never | positively | regularly
The word "hardly" means "almost never" (কদাচিৎ, প্রায় কখনোই না)। always = সবসময়; almost never = প্রায় কখনোই নয়; positively = ইতিবাচকভাবে; regularly = নিয়মিত।
The word 'hardly' means-
always | almost not | seriously | regularly
Hardly = নামেমাত্র, সবেমাত্র, প্রায় না (almost not বা scarcely)। Always = ক্রমাগত; Seriously = একান্তভাবে; Regularly = নিয়মিতভাবে।
The word hardly means-
very often | scarcely | positively | frequently
Hardly অর্থ কদাচিৎ বা না বললেই চলে, যা scarcely এর সমার্থক। very often = প্রায়শই; scarcely = কদাচিৎ; positively = সুস্পষ্টভাবে; frequently = বারবার।
What is the meaning of 'genocide'?
general destruction | killing of a king | killing of women and children | deliberate killing of a whole group or race of people

Genocide অর্থ গণহত্যা, অর্থাৎ deliberate killing of a whole group or race of people। general destruction = সাধারণ ধ্বংস; killing of a king = রাজহত্যা (regicide); killing of women and children = নারী ও শিশু হত্যা।
The word 'genocide' means-
mass grave | mass gathering | mass killing | mass attendance
Genocide শব্দটির অর্থ গণহত্যা (mass killing)। mass grave = গণকবর; mass gathering = গণ জমায়েত; mass attendance = গণ উপস্থিতি।
What may be considered courteous in one culture may be arrogant in another. Here the underlined word "arrogant" means
rude | gracious | coarse | pretentious
Arrogant অর্থ অহংকারী বা উদ্ধত, যার synonym হলো rude (অভদ্র বা উদ্ধত)। Gracious = দয়ালু/ভদ্র; Coarse = অমার্জিত বা কর্কশ; Pretentious = বড়াইপূর্ণ বা ভণ্ড।
What is the meaning of beneficial?
useful | benevolent | benefit | beneficial
Beneficial অর্থ উপকারী বা কল্যাণকর (useful)। benevolent = দয়ালু বা উদার; benefit = লাভ/উপকার; beneficial = উপকারী।
'Adulterate' means?
adult | pollute | contaminate | to make impure

Panacea অর্থ সর্বরোগহর ওষুধ বা সর্বরোগ নিরাময়কারী (a solution or remedy for all difficulties or diseases; cure all)।
One who is specialist in heart and its diseases is -
a cardiologist | a neurologist | an ophthalmologist | a pharmacologist
হৃদরোগ ও হৃদযন্ত্রের চিকিৎসার বিশেষজ্ঞ ডাক্তারকে Cardiologist বলা হয়।
The doctor who treats diseases of the brain is known as a/an—
pathologist | cardiologist | nephrologist | neurologist
মস্তিষ্ক, স্নায়ুতন্ত্র ও সুষুম্নাকাণ্ডের চিকিৎসার বিশেষজ্ঞ চিকিৎসককে Neurologist (স্নায়ুবিশেষজ্ঞ) বলে।
A doctor who studies and treats diseases of the nerve is—
a paediatrician | an oncologist | a nephrologist | a neurologist
স্নায়ুতন্ত্রের রোগব্যাধি নিয়ে গবেষণা ও চিকিৎসা করেন Neurologist (স্নায়ুরোগ বিশেষজ্ঞ)।
A specialist in eye disease is called a/an—
Optician | Neurologist | Cardiologist | Ophthalmologist
চক্ষুরোগের বিশেষজ্ঞ চিকিৎসককে Ophthalmologist বলা হয়। Optician হলেন চশমা ও লেন্স প্রস্তুতকারী।
Give one word for science of the structure of animal bodies —
Physiology | Anatomy | Biology | Psychology
জীবদেহ বা প্রাণিদেহের অভ্যন্তরীণ গঠনসংক্রান্ত বিজ্ঞানকে এক কথায় Anatomy (শরীরস্থানবিদ্যা) বলে। Physiology = শারীরবৃত্ত।
The doctor who treats kidney patients is called a/an:
pathologist | neurologist | nephrologists | cardiologist
কিডনি রোগের বিশেষজ্ঞ চিকিৎসককে Nephrologist বলা হয় (বা কিডনি ও মূত্রনালীর সার্জারির বিশেষজ্ঞকে Urologist বলা হয়)।
A medicine or substance that controls the effects of a poison or disease is called a/an — .
anaesthesia | panacea | placebo | antidote
বিষ বা রোগের বিষক্রিয়া ধ্বংসকারী বা প্রতিষেধক ওষুধকে Antidote (বিষনাশক) বলে। Anaesthesia = অবশকারী ওষুধ; Panacea = সর্বরোগহর ওষুধ; Placebo = মনস্তাত্ত্বিক সান্ত্বনামূলক ওষুধ।
A disease that cannot be cured is called a/an— .
incurable disease | runcurable disease | incorrigible disease | discurable disease
যে রোগ আরোগ্য করা বা সারানো যায় না তাকে Incurable disease (অনাবাস্য বা দুরারোগ্য ব্যাধি) বলে। Incorrigible = অসংশোধনযোগ্য।
A doctor who studies and treats the medical conditions and diseases of women is—
a gynaecologist | a neurologist | an oncologist | an Orthopaedic
মহিলা ও স্ত্রীরোগ সংক্রান্ত বিশেষজ্ঞ চিকিৎসককে Gynaecologist (স্ত্রীরোগ বিশেষজ্ঞ) বলা হয়।
The treatment of skin diseases is known as—
Darmitology | Dermitology | Dermatology | Dortmaitology
চর্মরোগ এবং ত্বকের চিকিৎসা সংক্রান্ত চিকিৎসাবিজ্ঞানের শাখাকে Dermatology (চর্মরোগবিদ্যা) বলে।
A ‘physician’ is a -
physicist | physique | a medical practitioner | a physical trainer
Physician অর্থ চিকিৎসাবিদ বা চিকিৎসক (a medical practitioner / doctor)। Physicist = পদার্থবিদ; Physique = শারীরিক গঠন; Physical trainer = শরীরচর্চা প্রশিক্ষক।
‘i.e’ stands for ‘id est’, which means-
such as | for example | namely | that is
ল্যাটিন শব্দসংক্ষেপ 'i.e.' (id est) এর ইংরেজি অর্থ হলো 'that is' (অর্থাৎ)। e.g. (exempli gratia) অর্থ for example (যেমন)।
The Latin expression ‘i.e’ stands for—
idest | ideal energy | inner edition | in Europe
ল্যাটিন ফ্রেইজ 'i.e.' এর পূর্ণরূপ হলো 'id est', ইংরেজিতে যার অর্থ 'that is'।
The idiom ‘sine die’ means-
doubtfully | uncertain | rigid | certain
Sine die (ল্যাটিন শব্দগুচ্ছ) অর্থ অনির্দিষ্টকালের জন্য (with no appointed date for resumption; indefinitely / uncertainly)।
What is the meaning of the phrase 'sine die'?
for a certain period | for an uncertain period | for a short time | none
'Sine die' অর্থ অনির্দিষ্টকালের জন্য (for an uncertain period বা indefinitely)।
Sine die means-
immediately | on his death | closed for the day | adjourned indefinitely
Sine die অর্থ অনির্দিষ্টকালের জন্য মুলতবি (adjourned indefinitely; without assigning a day for a further meeting or hearing)।
The abbreviation of a.m. is-
Anno meridiem | After morning | Ante meridiem | Anti-meriden
a.m. হলো ল্যাটিন 'Ante meridiem' এর সংক্ষিপ্ত রূপ, যার অর্থ 'দুপুরের পূর্বে' (before noon)। p.m. = Post meridiem (দুপুরের পরে)।
'Nota Bene' means
for example | not sure | next page | mark well
Nota Bene (সংক্ষেপে N.B.) একটি ল্যাটিন শব্দগুচ্ছ যার অর্থ বিশেষভাবে লক্ষণীয় বা মনোযোগ দিয়ে লক্ষ্য করুন (note well / mark well)।
The term 'prima facie' means —
the prime accused | the main figure | based on the first impression | according to the main facts
Prima facie ল্যাটিন শব্দ যার অর্থ প্রথম দর্শনে বা আপাতদৃষ্টিতে সত্য প্রতীয়মান (based on the first impression; accepted as correct until proved otherwise)।
What is the meaning of the word ‘Prima facie’?
Outlook | Face reading | At the first sight | Face to face
Prima facie এর অর্থ প্রথম দর্শনে বা আপাতদৃষ্টিতে (at the first sight / at first glance)।
The word 'lunar' is related to
Sun | Planet | moon | water
Lunar অর্থ চন্দ্র বা চাঁদ সংক্রান্ত (relating to or resembling the moon)। Solar = সূর্য সংক্রান্ত।
Full expression of N.B is-
Take Notice | Note Before | Nota Bene | Note Better
N.B. এর পূর্ণরূপ হলো ল্যাটিন 'Nota Bene', যার ইংরেজি অর্থ 'note well' বা 'mark well' (বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য)।
The word “retroactively” means
dating back | in the future | compounding | currently
Retroactively অর্থ পেছনের তারিখ থেকে কার্যকর হওয়া (with effect from a past date; dating back)।
'Vice-versa' refers to —
for example | face to face | namely | the terms being exchanged
Vice versa একটি ল্যাটিন বাক্যাংশ যার অর্থ বিপরীতক্রমে বা পরস্পর উল্টোভাবেও প্রযোজ্য (with the main items in the preceding statement the other way around; the terms being exchanged)।
What is the meaning of the word ‘viva voce’?
Examination | A spoken examination | Face to face | Interview
Viva voce (ল্যাটিন শব্দগুচ্ছ) অর্থ মৌখিক পরীক্ষা (an oral examination as opposed to a written one; a spoken examination)।
What is the meaning of the word ‘Viva voce’?
face to face | interview | examination | orally
Viva voce অর্থ মৌখিক পরীক্ষা বা সাক্ষাৎকার (oral interview / spoken examination)।
What is the meaning of the word ‘supersede’?
go faster | to take the place of something or somebody | move very fast | suppress
Supersede অর্থ অন্য কোনো ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর স্থান দখল করা বা স্থলাভিষিক্ত হওয়া (take the place of a person or thing previously in authority or use; to take the place of something or somebody)।
'En route' means-
on the way | on a plane | on a train | in the bus
'En route' ফরাসি শব্দগুচ্ছ যার অর্থ পথিমধ্যে বা যাত্রাপথে (during the course of a journey; on the way)।
The expression ‘lingua franca’ means —
The common language | The first language | International language | The French language
Lingua franca হলো ভিন্ন ভিন্ন মাতৃভাষার মানুষের মধ্যে পারস্পরিক যোগাযোগের সাধারণ ভাষা (a common language used for communication between people whose native languages are different)।
'Lingua Franca' means-
French language | A mixed language | Latin language | Translated version
Lingua Franca উৎপত্তিগতভাবে বিভিন্ন ভাষার মিশ্রণে তৈরি যোগাযোগের সাধারণ ভাষা (a common or mixed bridge language)।
Drizzling means
Raining heavily | Snowing lightly | Raining lightly | Snowing heavily
Drizzling অর্থ গুঁড়ি গুঁড়ি বা হালকা বৃষ্টি হওয়া (rain lightly in very small drops; raining lightly)। Raining heavily = ভারী বৃষ্টি।
The word ‘Bona-fide’ is similar to-
authentic | counterfeit | candid | capable
Bona-fide (ল্যাটিন শব্দগুচ্ছ) অর্থ খাঁটি, আসল বা বিশ্বস্ত (genuine; real; authentic)। Counterfeit = জাল/নকল।
De facto means:
de jure | two friends | in fact | surely
De facto ল্যাটিন শব্দগুচ্ছ যার অর্থ কার্যত বা প্রকৃতপক্ষে (in fact, or in effect, whether by right or not)। De jure = আইনগতভাবে।
Meaning of the word ‘Habeas Corpus’ is-
citizen's democratic right | fundamental rights of prisoners | freedom of jurisprudence | withdrawal of embassy

Habeas Corpus (ল্যাটিন শব্দগুচ্ছ) অর্থ বন্দিকে সশরীরে আদালতে হাজির করার রিট, যা বন্দিদের মৌলিক অধিকার রক্ষা করে (a writ requiring a person under arrest to be brought before a judge; fundamental rights of prisoners)।
What is the meaning of the word ‘Status quo’?
Equal status | State affair | High status | Face former state
Status quo (ল্যাটিন শব্দগুচ্ছ) অর্থ কোনো বিষয়ের বিদ্যমান অবস্থা বা পরিস্থিতি বজায় রাখা (the existing state of affairs)। বইয়ের উত্তর 'খ' (State affair) দেওয়া হয়েছে বিদ্যমান অবস্থা বা পরিস্থিতি অর্থে।
What is the meaning of the word ‘Ad valorem’?
Valueless | According to value | Valuable | Added valu
Ad valorem অর্থ পণ্যের আনুমানিক মূল্য অনুযায়ী ধার্যকৃত (according to value)।
Choose the correct expression — .
Five hundred taka | Five hundreds takas | Five hundred takas | Five hundreds taka
Taka একটি অপরিবর্তনীয়/গণনাহীন একবচনবাচক শব্দ হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং নির্দিষ্ট সংখ্যাবাচক শব্দের পর hundred এর সাথে 's' যুক্ত হয় না। তাই সঠিক এক্সপ্রেশন হলো 'Five hundred taka'।
The expression. He is all but ruined means
He has everything | He is out of danger | He is nearly ruined | He ruined others than himself
'All but' বাক্যাংশের অর্থ প্রায় বা কাছাকাছি (very nearly / almost)। তাই 'He is all but ruined' অর্থ সে প্রায় সর্বস্বান্ত বা ধ্বংসপ্রাপ্ত (He is nearly ruined)।
Which figure of speech do you find in the following expression? “I wandered lonely as a cloud”
simile | metaphor | personification | alliteration
দুটি ভিন্ন বস্তুর মধ্যে 'as' বা 'like' ব্যবহার করে প্রত্যক্ষ তুলনা করা হলে তাকে Simile (উপমা) বলে। এখানে 'as a cloud' ব্যবহৃত হওয়ায় এটি Simile।
You should show good manners in the company of young ladies. Which is the appropriate phrase for the underlined expression above?
behave gently | practise manners | behave yourself | do not talk rudely
'Show good manners' অর্থ মার্জিত বা শালীন আচরণ প্রদর্শন করা (behave gently / behave politely)।
What is the meaning of the expression 'that is to say':
following that | in spite of something | more accurately | there is no more to be said
'That is to say' এক্সপ্রেশনটি পূর্বের কথাকে আরও স্পষ্ট ও নিখুঁতভাবে ব্যাখ্যার জন্য ব্যবহৃত হয় (in other words; more accurately or precisely)।
Which of the following sentences expresses a request?
Would you mind opening the window | Would that he were here | Never do this | Liza and Shuvo are in love
'Would you mind + verb-ing' বিনীত অনুরোধ (polite request) প্রকাশের একটি বহুল প্রচলিত বাক্যকাঠামো।
What feeling is expressed in the sentence. "How dare you talk to me like that?"
Anger | Politeness | Gratitude | Greeting
"How dare you talk to me like that?" (আমার সাথে এভাবে কথা বলার সাহস তোমার কীভাবে হলো?) বাক্যটি তীব্র ক্রোধ বা অসন্তোষ (Anger) প্রকাশ করে।
`He is not himself' means—
He does not feel well | He is a different person | He is not what he seems to be | He is not a well-known person
'Be not oneself' একটি বাগধারা যার অর্থ অসুস্থ বা মানসিকভাবে স্বাভাবিক না থাকা (not feeling well physically or mentally; He does not feel well)।
The profession of Teaching is known as—
history | Pedagogy | Linguistic | Unknown
শিক্ষাদান পেশা বা শিক্ষাদর্শনকে Pedagogy বলা হয় (the method and practice of teaching)।
Amicable—
interesting | loving | affectionate | friendly
Amicable অর্থ বন্ধুত্বসুলভ, আন্তরিক ও সৌহার্দ্যপূর্ণ (friendly / cordial)।
The expression ‘an exciting and interesting time’ can be replaced by-
school of thought | white elephant | once in a blue moon | a whale of a time
'Have a whale of a time' একটি ইডিয়াম যার অর্থ অত্যন্ত আনন্দদায়ক ও রোমাঞ্চকর সময় কাটানো (an exciting and interesting time / a very enjoyable time)।
An Ordinance is—
a book | an arms factory | a newspaper | a law
Ordinance অর্থ অধ্যাদেশ, অর্থাৎ সংসদের অধিবেশন না থাকাকালে রাষ্ট্রপতির বিশেষ ক্ষমতাবলে জারিকৃত আইন (an authoritative order or decree; a law)।
He could not deny that.
Decide | Accept | Confusion | Refuse
Deny অর্থ কোনো কিছু অস্বীকার বা প্রত্যাখ্যান করা, যার কাছাকাছি অর্থ Refuse (বা reject)। Accept = গ্রহণ করা।
The lady had a puzzled look on her face.
Beautiful | Good | Happy | Unable to understand
Puzzled অর্থ বিভ্রান্ত, হতবুদ্ধি বা বুঝতে অক্ষম (confused or perplexed; unable to understand)।
It is inhuman not only to kill but also to purchase the migratory birds.
Beautiful | Native | Temporary | Bad
Migratory অর্থ পরিযায়ী বা যা সাময়িকভাবে এক অঞ্চল থেকে অন্য অঞ্চলে গমন করে (seasonal or temporary movement; temporary)।
Mr. Akash deals in diamonds.
Do business | Costly | Smuggling | Understands
'Deal in' একটি গ্রুপ ভার্ব যার অর্থ ব্যবসা করা (to engage in the business of buying and selling; do business)।
Science dealing with the behaviour of bodies in motion is called-
Statics | Semantics | Kinetics | Mnemonics
গতিশীল বস্তুর আচরণ ও গতি সংক্রান্ত পদার্থবিজ্ঞানের শাখাকে Kinetics (গতিবিদ্যা) বলা হয়। Statics = স্থিতিবিদ্যা; Semantics = শব্দার্থতত্ত্ব; Mnemonics = স্মৃতিসহায়িকা বিদ্যা।
Phoenix is-
an imaginary bullock | a mythical goat | a mythical bird regenerating from ashes | a dead mythical bird
Phoenix হলো গ্রিক পুরাণের এক অমর পৌরাণিক পাখি যা ভস্মস্তূপ থেকে পুনরায় পুনরুজ্জীবিত হয় (a mythical bird regenerating from ashes)।
What is the meaning of the word 'euphemism'?
inoffensive expression | vague idea | harsh word | wise saying
Euphemism অর্থ সুভাষণ অর্থাৎ কর্কশ বা অপ্রীতিকর কথার পরিবর্তে ব্যবহৃত মার্জিত বা শালীন প্রকাশভঙ্গি (an inoffensive expression substituted for one considered offensive)।
Synonyms - সমার্থক শব্দ ও প্রয়োগ
A synonym for 'vigilant' is-
watchful | careful | mindful | wakeful
Vigilant অর্থ সতর্ক বা সজাগ পাহারা দেওয়া (watchful / alert)। Careful = সাবধান; Mindful = যত্নবান; Wakeful = নির্ঘুম।
Pick the word that is synonymous with 'modesty':
timidity | humility | docility | simplicity

The synonym of the word 'dastard' is-

The Synonym of 'gain' is-

uplift | development | raising | increase
Growth অর্থ প্রবৃদ্ধি বা সার্বিক বিকাশ/উন্নতি (development)। Increase অর্থ পরিমাণ বৃদ্ধি।

Incredible অর্থ অবিশ্বাস্য (impossible to believe; unbelievable)।
'Fabulous' is a synonym of-

What is the synonym of 'Precarious'?

Precarious অর্থ অনিশ্চিত, বিপজ্জনক বা ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ (dangerously lacking in security or stability; hazardous / risky)।
The synonym of 'panacea' is-
remedy | germ | prevention | injury
Panacea অর্থ সর্বরোগের মহৌষধ বা নিরাময়কারী প্রতিকার (a remedy for all disease or difficulties; universal remedy)।
Which word has nearly the same meaning as 'grave'?

Grave (adjective হিসেবে) অর্থ গুরুতর, অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বা গম্ভীর (giving cause for alarm; serious / solemn)।
Which word is a synonym for 'benign'?
affable | cruel | kind | beneficial
Benign অর্থ সদয়, অমায়িক, দয়ালু বা ক্ষতিকর নয় এমন (gentle and kindly; kind)। Cruel = নিষ্ঠুর।
The synonym of the word “Luxury” is-
Austery | Poverty | Essential | Affluence
Luxury অর্থ বিলাসিতা বা প্রাচুর্যপূর্ণ জীবনযাপন (the state of great comfort and extravagant living; Affluence)। Austerity = কঠোরতা; Poverty = দারিদ্র্য।
Choose the appropriate synonym of the word: Perseverance.
Determination | Unstable | Rigid | Carelessness
Perseverance অর্থ অধ্যবসায়, অবিচল নিষ্ঠা বা দৃঢ়সংকল্প (persistence in doing something despite difficulty; Determination)।
The synonym for 'patient' is-
calm | sad | impatient | afraid
Patient (adjective হিসেবে) অর্থ ধৈর্যশীল বা শান্ত (able to accept or tolerate delays or suffering without getting upset; calm / tolerant)।
The synonym of the word ‘pacify’ is-
among | displease | encourage | appease
Pacify অর্থ শান্ত করা, প্রশমিত করা বা তুষ্ট করা (quell the anger, agitation, or excitement of; appease / soothe)।
The synonym of 'altitude' is
height | width | length | depth
Altitude অর্থ সমুদ্রপৃষ্ঠ থেকে উচ্চতা বা খাড়া উচ্চতা (the height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level; height)।
The synonym of ‘energetic’ is-
sprightly | hasty | humble | extreme
Energetic অর্থ কর্মোদ্যমী, প্রাণবন্ত বা চঞ্চল (showing or involving great activity or vitality; sprightly / lively)।
Which is the closest meaning of the word ‘Curious’?
